description.zh: 二段跳、高亮、R 拿取、头灯、基础负重、快存与格子锁、菜单暂停、同列车供料和 O 回列车；可选设备防寒损、工具武器不磨损、种植及物品生成倍率。
description.en: Double jump, highlights, take all, headlamp, carry weight, quick stash and slot locks, menu pause, train supply and O to return to the train; optional cold damage protection, no item wear, farming and loot multipliers.
